==Russian==

===Etymology===
From {{af|ru|верте́ть|-нуть}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*vьrtě̀ti}}. Compare {{cog|lt|verčiù}}, {{m|lt|ver̃sti}}, {{m|lt|vir̃sti}}, {{cog|lv|vḕrst}}, {{cog|la|verto}}, {{cog|got|𐍅𐌰𐌹𐍂𐌸𐌰𐌽}}, {{cog|grc|ῥατάνη}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|верну́ть}}
** {{audio|ru|Ru-вернуть.ogg}}
* {{IPA|ru|[vʲarˈnutʲ]|a=Southern Russia}} (''phonetic respelling'': вярну́ть)
* {{IPA|ru|[vʲirˈnut͡sʲ]|a=Belarus}} (''phonetic respelling'': верну́ць)
* {{IPA|ru|[ʋʲirˈnutʲ]|a=Ukraine}}
* {{rhymes|ru|utʲ|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|верну́ть|pf|impf=возвраща́ть}}

# to [[return]], to [[give back]]
#: {{syn|ru|возврати́ть}}
# to [[recover]], to [[get back]]
#: {{syn|ru|возврати́ть}}
